transcript_raw:
Participant: P02 | Session 1 | GTA V | full HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 1.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:18] P02: um, like, [silence 6s] I kept looking at the waypoint marker and drove toward it.
[00:50] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:55] P02: um, uh, not really, everything was pretty clear.
[01:34] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:40] P02: uh, you know, [silence 7s] the pop-up notifications uh, pulled my focus away. Like I said, I'm [participant], I play this at home.
[02:04] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[02:08] P02: um, uhm the marker got confusing when I like, was inside a building.
[02:38] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:45] P02: uh, ahh, honestly time went by fast.
[03:06] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[03:11] P02: ahh, uh, no, I never really had uhm to stop, the map told me everything.
[03:30] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:35] P02: uhm uh, [silence 8s] nothing was missing, if ahh, anything there was too much.
[03:50] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[03:55] P02: like, um, [silence 6s] I would make the like, HUD smaller and remove some of the notifications.
